notes.title: Tales of Yore - Oasis Update
notes.notes:
The Oasis Update

It's finally here, the Oasis update is released adding: 


130,000 new tiles to explore
100s of new items including weapons, armor and spells
30+ new quests
30+ new monsters
7 new dungeons
8 new bosses
New fishing rods, pick axes, recipes and enchantments
3 new towns
More hats, so many more hats!


It's been a long time coming, hope to see you in game!

notes.title: Abilities Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41935952/e0ba094038633c15bdf5f9de61e10ef97cc5c610.png

Here it is, the abilities update, if you though magic users had the best builds - check out these ranged and melee based abilities!

You can now train your hero in a total of 22 different abilities from the simple Stun and Double Shot, to the specialist skills of Momentum and Decapitate. Fear not, there are always more evil creatures to slay either alone or together as part of a party.

Journey Onwards!
